reference.title: Troubleshoot a Splunk integration
reference.shortdesc: Review the following issues if your Hybrid Cloud Console integration with Splunk is not working as expected.

section.title: Splunk does not receive event notifications from the Hybrid Cloud Console
section.p: Configuration errors in the Splunk environment can result in Splunk not receiving event notifications from the Hybrid Cloud Console.

ul.li: In Splunk, make sure that the HTTP Event Collector (HEC) is enabled under Global Settings. See .
Make sure that the default index is redhatinsights.

Make sure the firewall allows for incoming requests on the configured Splunk HEC port (default for Splunk Enterprise is 8088, and default for Splunk Cloud is 443). If you are using AWS for your instance, allow any of the ports Splunk might need. For more information, refer to Splunk Phantom ports and endpoints.

section.p: For more information about configuring Splunk HEC ports, see Splunk Phantom ports and endpoints.

section.title: Cannot click links in the Events table in Splunk when using real-time search
section.p: In Splunk, if you select a relative value from the Timestamp field in the Events table, you can then click any displayed event in the table to display a new tab with information about the affected system or policy.

However, if you select a real-time value from the Timestamp field, the displayed events do not respond when clicked. This is a limitation in Splunk. Splunk recommends that you avoid clicking real-time events to view event details.
